boundary.message: Something unexpected happened. Try again. If it continues, reload the page.
boundary.title: Something went wrong

gameNotFound.hint: Search for the game again and link the manual again.
gameNotFound.message: The selected game no longer exists in the catalog.
gameNotFound.title: Game not found

gameUnavailable.hint: Return to the catalog and select another game.
gameUnavailable.message: This game is no longer available for new questions.
gameUnavailable.title: Game unavailable

identityUnavailable.hint: Sign in or try a different username.
identityUnavailable.message: An account with that email or username already exists.
identityUnavailable.title: Email or username unavailable

invalidPdf.hint: Export the manual as a PDF and try again.
invalidPdf.message: The file is not a valid PDF.
invalidPdf.title: Invalid PDF

manualContextNotFound.hint: Wait for processing to finish or upload a valid manual.
manualContextNotFound.message: No indexed manuals are available to answer questions about that game.
manualContextNotFound.title: Not enough context

manualDuplicate.hint: Open the existing manual or upload a different version.
manualDuplicate.message: This manual is already in your library for this game.
manualDuplicate.title: Duplicate manual

manualTooLarge.hint: Reduce the image files or split the manual into several uploads.
manualTooLarge.message: The combined image files can be up to 95 MB.
manualTooLarge.title: Manual too large

noManualSources.hint: Upload the game's manual again to ask questions.
noManualSources.message: A source you used is no longer available, so you can't ask new questions in this conversation.
noManualSources.title: Source unavailable

pdfTooLarge.hint: Reduce the PDF size or split the manual into a smaller file.
pdfTooLarge.message: The PDF can be up to 95 MB.
pdfTooLarge.title: PDF too large

400.hint: Check the details and try again.
400.message: Something in the request was incorrect.
400.title: Invalid request

401.message: Your session has expired or you aren't signed in.
401.title: Session expired

403.hint: Reload the page and try again.
403.message: You don't have permission to perform this action, or the security token has expired.
403.title: Action not allowed

404.hint: Go back to the home screen and upload the photos again.
404.message: This manual no longer exists on the server.
404.title: Manual not found

409.hint: Check the details and try again.
409.message: That data is already in use or unavailable.
409.title: Data unavailable

413.hint: Reduce the file size and try again.
413.message: The upload exceeds the allowed size.
413.title: File too large

415.hint: Convert the file and try again.
415.message: The file is not a valid image (JPG, PNG) or PDF.
415.title: Unsupported format

422.hint: Make sure the photos are in focus and well lit, then try again.
422.message: We couldn't extract text from the pages.
422.title: Couldn't read the manual

429.hint: Wait a moment before trying again.
429.message: You've made too many requests in a short time.
429.title: Too many attempts

500.hint: Try again. If the problem continues, report the error code.
500.title: Something went wrong

502.hint: Wait a few seconds and try again.
502.message: An internal service is still starting up or unavailable.
502.title: Service starting

504.hint: Try again or use fewer pages.
504.message: The response took longer than expected.
504.title: Request timed out

server.hint: Try again in a few seconds.
server.title: Server error

network.hint: Check your internet connection and try again.
network.title: No connection

unknown.hint: Reload the page or try again.
unknown.title: Unexpected error
